spans.s: चतुर् a. (nom. pl. चत्वार m.; चतस्र f.; चत्वारि n.) Four, देहि मे चतुरो ग्रामान् कंचिदेकं च पंचमम् Ve.i., शेषान् मासान् गमय चतुरो लोचने मीलयित्वा Megh.ii.47, चत्वारो वयमृत्विजः Ve.i.
चतुर्-अंश m. fourth part.
चतुर्-अंग (I) a. quadripartite or consisting of four members.

चतुर्-अंग (II) n. 1. an entire army consisting of foot, horse, elephants and chariots, e.g. चतुरंगबलो राजा जगतीं वशमानयेत् । अहं पंचांगबलवान् आकाशं वशमानये, or एको हि खंजनवरो नलिनीदलस्थो दृष्टः करोति चतुरंगबलाधिपत्यम् Sr.
; 2. a sort of chess.
चतुर्-अंत a. bordered on all sides, भूत्वा चिराय चतुरंतमही सपत्नी Sak.iv.
चतुर्-अंता f. the earth.
चतुर्-अशीत a. eighty-fourth.
चतुर्-अशीति a. or f. eighty-four.
चतुर्-अश्र, -अस्र (I) a. 1. four-cornered, quadrangular; 2. symmetrical, बभूव तस्याश्चतुरस्रशोभि वपुः K.S.i.32.
चतुर्-अश्र, -अस्र (I) a. 1. four-cornered, quadrangular; 2. symmetrical, बभूव तस्याश्चतुरस्रशोभि वपुः K.S.i.32.
चतुर्-अस्र (II) m. a square.
चतुर्-अह n. a period of four days.
चतुर्-आनन m. an epithet of Brahman (m.) इतरतापशतानि यथेच्छया वितर तानि सहे चतुरानन Ud.
चतुर्-आश्रम n. the four stages of the religious life of a Brāhmaṇa.
चतुर्-उत्तर a. increasing by four.
चतुष्कर्ण a. heard by two persons only.
चतुष्कोण (I) a. square, quadrangular.
चतुष्कोण (II) m. a square, a tetragon.
चतुर्-गति m. 1. the supreme soul; 2. a tortoise.
चतुर्-गुण a. four times, fourfold, quadruple.
चतुश्चत्वारिंश a. forty-fourth.
चतुर्णवत a. with ninety-four added, e.g. चतुर्णवतं शतम् ‘one hundred and ninty-four.’
चतुर्-दंत m. an epithet of Airāvata, the elephant of Indra.
चतुर्-दश a. fourteenth.
चातुर्दश n. A demon.
चतुर्-दशन् a. fourteen.
चतुर्-दशन्˚धा ind. in fourteen ways.
चतुर्-दशन्˚विद्या f. pl. the fourteen lores (they are- षडंगमिश्रिता वेदा धर्मशास्त्रं पुराणकम् । मीमांसा तर्कमपि च एता विद्याश्चतुर्दश).
चतुर्-दशी f. the fourteenth day of a lunar fortnight.
चतुर्-दिश n. the four quarters (collectively).
चतुर्-दिशम् ind. towards the four quarters, on all sides.
चतुर्-दोल m.n. a royal litter.
चतुर्-द्वार n. 1. a house with four entrances on four sides; 2. four doors (collectively).
चतुर्-धा ind. in four ways, fourfold.
चतुर्-नवति a. or f. ninty-four.
चतुःपंच a. four or five.
चतुःपंच a. four or five.
चतुःपंचाशत् a. or f. fifty-four.
चतुःपंचाशत् a. or f. fifty-four.
चतुःपथ (I) m.n. a place where four roads meet, a crossway, M.iv.39.
चतुःपथ (I) m.n. a place where four roads meet, a crossway, M.iv.39.
चतुष्पथ (II) m. a Brāhmaṇa.
चतुष्पद (I) m. 1. having four feet; 2. consisting of four lines.
चतुष्पद (II) m. a quadruped.
चतुष्पाद (I) a. 1. quadruped; 2. consisting of four members or parts.
चतुष्पाद (II) m. 1. a quadruped; 2. a judicial proceeding consisting of four processes, viz., plea, defence, rejoinder and judgment (in law).
चतुष्पदी f. a stanza of four lines (पद्यं चतुष्पदी तच्च वृत्तं जातिरिति द्विधा).
चतुष्पाठी f. a school for Brāhmaṇas in which the four Vedas are repeated.
चतुष्पाणि m. an epithet of Viṣṇu.
चतुर्-बाहु (I) m. an epithet of Viṣṇu.
चतुर्-बाहु (II) n. a square.
चतुर्-भद्र n. the aggregate of the four ends of human life, viz., धर्म, अर्थ, काम and मोक्ष.
चतुर्-भाग m. the fourth part, a quarter.
चतुर्-भुज (I) a. 1. quadrangular; 2. having four arms, Bg.xi.46.
चतुर्-भुज (II) m. an epithet of Viṣṇu, R.xvi.3.
चतुर्-भुज (III) n. a square.
चतुर्-मास n. a period of four months.
चतुर्-मुख (I) a. having four faces.
चतुर्-मुख (II) m. an epithet of Brahman (m.), त्वत्तः सर्वं चतुर्मुखात् R.x.22.
चतुर्-मुख (III) n. a house with four doors.
चतुर्-युग n. the aggregate of the four yugas or ages of the world.
चतूरात्र n. an aggregate of four nights.
चतुर्-वक्त्र m. an epithet of Brahman (m.).
चतुर्-वर्ग m. the four ends of human life (collectively), viz., धर्म, अर्थ, काम and मोक्ष R.x.22.
चतुर्-वर्ण m. the four classes or castes of the Hindus, viz., ब्राह्मण, क्षत्रिय, वैश्य and शूद्र, चतुर्वर्णमयो लोकः R.x.22.
चतुर्-वर्षिका f. a cow four years old.
चतुर्विंश a. 1. the twenty-fourth; 2. having twenty-four added.
चतुर्-विंशति a. or f. twenty-four.
चतुर्-विंशतिक a. consisting of twenty-four.
चतुर्-विद्य a. one who has studied the four Vedas.
चतुर्-विद्या f. the four Vedas.
चतुर्-विध a. of four sorts or kinds, fourfold, M.ii.12.
चतुर्-वेद (I) a. familiar with the four Vedas.
चतुर्-वेद (II) m. the supreme soul.
चतुर्-व्यूह n. medical science.
चतुर्-हायण, -हायन a. four years old. (The fem. of this word ends in ई, if it relates to an animal, in आ if it relates to an inanimate thing).
चतुर्-हायण, -हायन a. four years old. (The fem. of this word ends in ई, if it relates to an animal, in आ if it relates to an inanimate thing).
चतुर्-होत्रक n. the foot Vedas (collectively).
चतुःशाल f. a square of four buildings, a quadrangle enclosed by four buildings, Ve.i.
चतुःशाल f. a square of four buildings, a quadrangle enclosed by four buildings, Ve.i.
चतुःशाल f. a square of four buildings, a quadrangle enclosed by four buildings, Ve.i.
चतुःशाल f. a square of four buildings, a quadrangle enclosed by four buildings, Ve.i.
चतुर्-षष्टि a. or f. sixty-four.
चतुर्-षष्टि˚कला f. pl. the sixty-four arts.
चतुर्-सप्तति a. or f. seventy-four.
चतुर (I) a. (f. रा) 1. Swift, quick; 2. clever, skilful, ingenious, मृगया जहार चतुरेव कामिनी R.ix.69, xviii.15, Am.
; 3. charming, agreeable, न पुनरेति गतं चतुरं वयः R.ix.47, K.S.i.47.
चतुर (II) n. 1. Cleverness, ingenuity; 2. an elephant’s stable.
चतुर (I) a. (f. रा) 1. Swift, quick; 2. clever, skilful, ingenious, मृगया जहार चतुरेव कामिनी R.ix.69, xviii.15, Am.
; 3. charming, agreeable, न पुनरेति गतं चतुरं वयः R.ix.47, K.S.i.47.
चातुर (I) a. (f. री) 1. Relating to four; 2. clever, able; 3. speaking well, flattering; 4. perceptible.
चातुर (II) n. A four-wheeled carriage.
चतुर्थ (I) a. (f. र्थी) The fourth.
चतुर्थ (II) n. A quarter.
चतुर्थ (I) a. (f. र्थी) The fourth.
चतुर्थी f. 1. The fourth day of a lunar fortnight; 2. the dative case (in gram.).
चतुर्थ-आश्रम m. the fourth of a Brāhmaṇa’s religious life, Sannyāsa.
चतुर्थ-भाज् a. (a king) receiving a fourth part of all income from the subject on occasions of financial difficulties.
चतुर्थक m. An intermittent fever returning every four days (in medicine).
चातुर्थक (f. की) (I) a. Quartan, occurring every fourth day.
चातुर्थक (II) m. A quartan ague.
चतुर्थी-कर्मन् n. the ceremonies performed on the fourth day of the marriage.
चतुष्क (I) a. (f. ष्का) Consisting of four, increased by four, e.g. चतुष्कं शतम् = 104 or four per cent, M.viii.142).
चतुष्क (II) n. 1. A collection of four; 2. a crossway; 3. a quadrangular courtyard; 4. a hall supported by four columns, K.S.v.63, vii.9.
चतुष्क (I) a. (f. ष्का) Consisting of four, increased by four, e.g. चतुष्कं शतम् = 104 or four per cent, M.viii.142).
चतुष्की f. 1. A large foursided pond; 2. a musquito-curtain.
चतुष्टय (I) a. (f. यी) Fourfold, consisting of four, प्रवृत्तिरासीच्छब्दानां चरितार्था चतुष्टयी K.S.ii.17.
चतुष्टय (II) n. 1. A gronp of four, युक्तं मणिस्तंभचतुष्टयेन K.S.vii.12; 2. a square.
चतुष्टय (I) a. (f. यी) Fourfold, consisting of four, प्रवृत्तिरासीच्छब्दानां चरितार्था चतुष्टयी K.S.ii.17.
चत्वर n. 1. A quadrangular place or courtyard; 2. a place where many ways meet, स खलु श्रेष्ठिचत्वरे निवसति Mrich.ii.; 3. a level spot of ground prepared for a sacrifice.
चत्वारिंशत् f. Forty.
चत्वाल m. 1. A hole in the ground prepared for sacred fire; 2. kuśa grass.
चात्वाल m. 1. A hole in the ground to receive sacrificial fire; 2. kuśa grass.
चातक m. (fem. ˚की) Name of a bird which is supposed to live only on rain-drops, वामश्चायं नदति मधुरं चातकस्ते सगंधः Megh.i.9, Rt.ii.3.
चातक-आनंदन m. 1. the rainy season; 2. a cloud.
चातन n. The act of injuring.
चातुर (I) a. (f. री) 1. Relating to four; 2. clever, able; 3. speaking well, flattering; 4. perceptible.
चातुरी f. Dexterity, skill, ability, तद्भटचातुरी तुरी Na.i.12.
चातुरक्ष (I) n. Four casts in playing at dice.
चातुरक्ष (II) m. A small round pillow.
चातुरर्थिक m. A suffix affixed in four particular senses (in gram.).
चातुराश्रमिक a. (f. की) Being in one of the four periods of the life of a Brāhmaṇa. See under आश्रम.
चातुराश्रमिक a. (f. की) Being in one of the four periods of the life of a Brāhmaṇa. See under आश्रम.
चातुराश्रम्य m. The four periods of the life of a Brāhmaṇa. See under आश्रम.
चातुरिक m. A charioteer, a coachman.
चातुर्थक (f. की) (I) a. Quartan, occurring every fourth day.
चातुर्थाह्निक a. (f. की) Belonging to the fourth day.
चातुर्थाह्निक a. (f. की) Belonging to the fourth day.
चातुर्दशिक m. One who studies on the fourteenth day of a lunar fortnight (study not being allowed on that day).
चातुर्मासक a. (f. सिका) One who performs the Chaturmāsya sacrifice.
चातुर्मासक a. (f. सिका) One who performs the Chaturmāsya sacrifice.
चातुर्मास्य n. Name of the sacrifice performed every four months, viz., at the beginning of Kārtīka, Phālguna, and Āshāḍha.
चातुर्य n. Dexterity, skill, shrewdness, ability, भ्रूचातुर्याकुंचिताक्षाः कटाक्षाः Bhartr.i.3.
चातुर्वर्ण्य n. 1. The aggregate of the four original castes of the Hindus, चातुर्वर्ण्यं मया सृष्टं गुणकर्मविभागशः Bg.vi.13; 2. the duties of these four castes.
चातुर्विध्य n. Fourfold division, four kinds (collectively).
चातुराश्रमिन् a. (f. णी) Being in one of the four periods of the life of a Brāhmaṇa. See under आश्रम.
चातुराश्रमिन् a. (f. णी) Being in one of the four periods of the life of a Brāhmaṇa. See under आश्रम.

चातुर्थिक (II) m. A quartan ague.
